Scene:
可是夹竹桃的毒很重，让他肚子很痛。他在地上躺着，觉得他快会死了。可是正好有别人找到他了，给了他一个像伞的植物，叫灵芝。他吃灵芝以后就觉得很好，不再生病了。他测量起来了，像星星的植物是毒，像伞的植物是药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 可是夹竹桃的毒很重：很强
- 觉得他快会死了：快要死了
- 可是正好有别人找到他了：有人，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”
- 他吃灵芝以后就觉得很好：吃了，了completed
- 他测量起来了：写下来了

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Temporality): 吃灵芝以后：吃了灵芝以后，Eating is completed before the later feeling of recovery, so the completed action needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 2: Coherence (Temporality): 吃灵芝以后：吃了灵芝以后，This refers to one completed act of eating, so add 了 to mark completion before 以后. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 3: Coherence (Temporality): 吃灵芝以后：吃了灵芝以后，The eating is a completed action before he feels better, so add 了 to mark completion. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
